title: AARYA Voice Lab Processing History Record (VL-D4 §16, §18)
description: Provenance for one voice-processing run against a recording -- boundary conditioning + normalization + noise-conditioning decision, bundled into one derived artifact. Records are immutable; a correction or rollback appends a new record referencing the one it supersedes via `supersedes`, so history is never silently overwritten. `recorded_at` describes the event and is never used as identity -- `record_id` is.

artifact_id.description: Deterministic derived-artifact identity (pipeline.resume.StageFingerprint digest) -- same source + profile + config + tool version always yields the same id. Empty string when processing was blocked before an artifact could be produced.

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the derived output. Null when no artifact was produced (a BLOCKED/FAILED run).

supersedes.description: record_id of the version this one displaces as active, if any (including a rollback target). Never edit a prior record -- append a new one referencing it.
